culprit_citations.quoted_text: Mobotrex Acquisition, LLC Revolver fair value $89,730 and % of net assets 0.04%

rationale: Class 3 anchor check: the filing schedule and balance sheet agree that net assets are $199,626,715 and total investments are $400,131,924. The source schedule expresses investment rows as percent of net assets rounded to two decimals. The largest residual row is explained by rounding: Mobotrex Acquisition, LLC Revolver has fair value $89,730; $89,730 / $199,626,715 * 100 = 0.0449498902%, which rounds to the printed 0.04%. Reconstructing fair value from the rounded percentage implies about $79,850.69 and creates the approximately $9,879.31 residual, so the stored source values are internally consistent and the flag is an over-tight identity check rather than a data error.
